name: expense-api
description: Single backend for the expense product: owns claims and their lifecycle (draft, submitted, approved, rejected, withdrawn), the fixed category list, the manager decision with optimistic version check, payroll export batches (CSV, each approved claim exported once), company-wide reporting and CSV download, and the audit log of every submission, edit, withdrawal, decision and export. Reach is by path: /me/claims for the caller's claims, /me/team/claims for direct reports (resolved from the employee's manager relation), everything else for Finance. One service because every capability shares the same claim data and lifecycle; it does not hold a people directory (the manager relation is meant to come from the organization's directory), send notifications, or store receipts.

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores claims, lines, categories, employees' manager relation, payroll export batches and the audit log.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in: the gateway validates tokens issued by the project's identity provider.
